ValidationRule.description: This validation rule is used to make sure that only one type of participant can be provided for a record.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Participating_Contact__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Participating_Lead__c))), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Participating_Lead__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Participating_User__c))), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Participating_User__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Participating_Contact__c))) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please make sure that only one type of participant (Contact/Lead/User) should be provided for the record!
